title: Waiting at a red light
intro: A traffic signal's red phase lasts 60 s. A car that arrives during the red at a random moment waits X seconds, uniform between a = 0 and b = 60. The shaded area is the probability of waiting between 15 and 45 s: (45 − 15)/60 = 0.5. P(X ≤ 15) = 15/60 = 0.25, the mean wait is (0 + 60)/2 = 30 s, and the standard deviation is 60/√12 = 17.32 s.
